description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for Claims to Land Parcel in D/S Division, Kesbewa and Other Land Parcels
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership interests across multiple districts. The content focuses entirely on land administration and property rights, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and related matters.
